Patch Notes - October 8, 2026

Bonus Stats at Lv. 70 and Above

  • Added the following bonus stats from level 70.
    • Extra AP Against Monsters +3 and Monster Damage Reduction +3 are gained from level 70 and onwards.
    • These stats also apply to tagged characters, regardless of that character's level.
      • Example: If character A at level 70 and character B at level 66 are tagged, character B also gains Extra AP Against Monsters +9 and Monster Damage Reduction +9 based on character A's level.
Level Extra AP Against Monsters Monster Damage Reduction

70

 3 3
71 6 6
72 9 9
73 12 12
74 15 15
75 18 18
* These bonus stats do not stack.
 
  • Bonus stats gained from levels can be found under "Detailed Stats" in My Stats UI.
    • Example: Extra AP Against Monsters and Monster Damage Reduction applied at Lv. 75
 

My Information (P) UI Improvements

  • Improved the My Information (P) UI to show more detailed level and EXP info for your current character.
    • The current EXP and the EXP required to reach the next level can be checked, in addition to the level.
  • Removed the Bio area. You can now set your Bio in the portrait area at the top left.
 

Combat EXP System Revamp

  • Revamped the Combat EXP system.
    • Changed the Combat EXP required to reach the next level for all level ranges.
    • Adjusted the EXP obtained from defeating any monsters.
    • Adjusted the Combat EXP obtained from quests.
    • Changed the EXP obtained per level through Black Spirit's Training.
    • Added a level-based cap on the Combat EXP obtainable from killing a single monster.
      • The cap includes Combat EXP increase effects.

Monster Zone Info UI

  • Added information on the monsters that appear in each zone and the EXP obtainable from defeating them to Monster Zone Info.
    • The "#CombatEXP" tag has been removed from Monster Zone Info.
 

Monster Info UI

  • Improved the monster info UI at the top of the screen to show the monster's level.
 

Rules and Benefits Based on Level Difference

  • Changed the monster name color rules based on the level difference between Adventurers and monsters.
    • The number of monster name color tiers based on level difference has been reduced from 11 to 7.
  • Added a benefit that reduces damage taken from monsters of a lower level.
    • For each level you are above a monster, you gain Monster Damage Reduction +3 against that monster's attacks.
      • This effect applies for a level difference of up to 3, granting a maximum of Monster Damage Reduction +9.

Combat EXP Through Combat Content

  • Added Combat Secret Books that grant Combat EXP, obtainable from the following PvE and PvP content.
    • You can use Combat Secret Books after completing the "[To Level 50!] Go Beyond Your Own Limits" quest.
    • The amount of Combat EXP each type of Combat Secret Book grants based on Lv. 66 is as follows.

  • Removed the "#CombatEXP" and "#SkillEXP" tags from the Monster Zone Info UI.
  • Added the recommended level before each zone name in the Monster Zone Info UI.
  • Increased the Combat/Skill EXP gain from the Body Enhancement buff obtainable at Campsites, from 50% to 100%.
  • Increased the Combat/Skill EXP gain from the Adventure's Boon buff obtainable by talking to NPCs or at Campsites, from 15% to 30%.
  • Increased the bonus Combat EXP for equipping 4 parts of a Pearl Outfit from 10% to 50%.
  • Increased the bonus Skill EXP for equipping 6 parts of a Pearl Outfit from 10% to 50%.
